draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) reported that salience pre-filtering reduced unsupported-entity hallucinations in news summarization.
revised_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) reported that salience pre-filtering reduced the share of summaries containing an unsupported entity by 31% relative to the unfiltered summarizer across three news summarization benchmarks.
rationale: P1 states the reduction (31%, from 14.2% to 9.8%) across three benchmarks. The sentence is accurate but omits the reported magnitude and scope, so a stronger, equally supported version is available.
